Open questions: Discovery should first establish available runtime capabilities and any applicable project conventions; until then, recorded defaults are a minimal HTTP API, unauthenticated callers, and shared event and reservation state available to all callers of one running service instance. These defaults rule out verified identities, private reservations, cross-instance sharing, and persistence across restarts unless discovery establishes a need or existing support. Discovery should establish how concurrent reservations are handled and what happens at capacity before implementation; the recorded default is that successful reservations must not exceed available seats.
